subject.title: fix(agent): classify stuck recovery as idle timeout

question: Should this PR land as the downstream stuck-recovery classification boundary now that the provider-owned opencode-go stream fix has already merged?
rationale: The patch appears technically sound, but it intentionally changes retry/fallback semantics for active model-call recovery and should be accepted by the agent/session owner rather than merged by automation alone.

options.title: Land after owner review
options.body: Accept the PR as defense-in-depth for diagnostic recovery after confirming the model/tool/stale classification boundary is the intended session-state contract.

options.title: Defer for timeout-budget ordering
options.body: Wait for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/98580 if maintainers want to settle when recovery fires before merging what happens after it fires.

options.title: Close as redundant
options.body: Close only if maintainers decide the merged provider-boundary fix fully replaces downstream classification hardening.

recommendation.title: Land after owner review
